segments.t: 在这个周日的早晨，波特兰的林登庭院客栈（Linden Courtyard Inn）里，亚瑟在柜台旁来回踱步，手里拿着三页写满紧张笔记的纸，而汉娜和泰莎则在端咖啡，并整理这一周的安排。请先听一遍完整的场景。
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday at three o'clock the city clerk walks in!
Sit down and drink your hot coffee before you spill it, Arthur.
Look at our whiteboard: three days, three simple jobs.
Only three jobs?! Yesterday Room Nine was full of dust and silent piano keys!
Sunday: wash every window and read your aunt's old green guest book.
Monday: paint the outside shutters warm green and arrange twelve chairs.
Tuesday: repair the silent piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!
When you divide a mountain into three small hills, I can breathe again!
Where did you put that old green guest book from the attic, Arthur?
Right here under my arm! Wait, where did I put my coffee cup?
In your left hand, Arthur.
Go rest for ten minutes, boss. Hannah and Evelyn will read the book!
现在我们一步一步地回顾这个场景。
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday at three o'clock the city clerk walks in!
“星期日，星期一，星期二，然后星期三三点整市政官员进来！”为了更生动地描述日程表上即将到来的约会，可以使用现在时：
the city clerk walks in!
这里的 walk in 描绘了穿过门的确切瞬间。
Sit down and drink your hot coffee before you spill it, Arthur.
“坐下趁热喝你的咖啡，亚瑟，别弄洒了。”当液体因为突然的动作从杯子里溢出时，合适的动词是：
before you spill it,
在 before 之后用现在时。
Look at our whiteboard: three days, three simple jobs.
“看我们的白板：三天，三个简单的任务。”用来安排轮班或计划的白板被称为：
whiteboard:
像 blackboard 一样，是由一个词组成的。
Only three jobs?! Yesterday Room Nine was full of dust and silent piano keys!
“只有三个任务！？昨天九号房间满是灰尘和不出声的钢琴键！”要描述一个充满或覆盖着某物的房间，可以用 full 加上 of：
full of dust
而 silent piano keys 指的是按下时不发声的琴键。
Sunday: wash every window and read your aunt's old green guest book.
“星期日：清洗每一扇窗户，并阅读你姑姑那本绿色的旧登记簿。”请注意所有格是如何开启一连串非常有条理的形容词的：
your aunt's old green
先把表示新旧的 old 放在前面，然后是颜色 green。
Monday: paint the outside shutters warm green and arrange twelve chairs.
“星期一：把外面的百叶窗刷成暖绿色，并摆放十二把椅子。”在动词 paint 之后，结果的颜色直接跟在后面，不需要介词：
paint the outside shutters warm green
而 arrange 意思是按顺序安排或布置。
Tuesday: repair the silent piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!
“星期二：修理那颗不出声的钢琴键，并烤好星期三的柠檬果挞！”时间所有格的另一个完美例子出现在：
Wednesday's lemon tarts!
把烘焙任务直接分配到了活动当天。
When you divide a mountain into three small hills, I can breathe again!
“当你把一座大山分成三座小山丘时，我又能呼吸了！”要将一个大问题分成易于处理的部分，divide 与 into 连用：
divide a mountain into three small hills,
标记出整体被分成了什么。
Where did you put that old green guest book from the attic, Arthur?
“你把阁楼里那本绿色的旧登记簿放哪儿了，亚瑟？”动词 put 的现在时、过去时和过去分词形式完全相同，所以在：
Where did you put
是由助动词 did 来指示过去时。
Right here under my arm! Wait, where did I put my coffee cup?
“就在胳膊底下夹着呢！等等，我把咖啡杯放哪儿了？”对于夹在身体侧面和手臂之间的东西，可以说是：
under my arm!
在亚瑟再次上演他经典的迷糊行为之前。
In your left hand, Arthur.
“在你的左手里，亚瑟。”这里：
left hand,
将 left 作为表示方向的形容词，而不是场景标题 Three Days Left 中 leave 的过去分词 left。
Go rest for ten minutes, boss. Hannah and Evelyn will read the book!
“去休息十分钟吧，老板。汉娜和伊芙琳会看那本书的！”在北美日常对话中，go 后面可以直接跟另一个动词原形：
Go rest
语气亲切且实用。让我们把整段对话连起来再听一遍。
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday at three o'clock the city clerk walks in!
Sit down and drink your hot coffee before you spill it, Arthur.
Look at our whiteboard: three days, three simple jobs.
Only three jobs?! Yesterday Room Nine was full of dust and silent piano keys!
Sunday: wash every window and read your aunt's old green guest book.
Monday: paint the outside shutters warm green and arrange twelve chairs.
Tuesday: repair the silent piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!
When you divide a mountain into three small hills, I can breathe again!
Where did you put that old green guest book from the attic, Arthur?
Right here under my arm! Wait, where did I put my coffee cup?
In your left hand, Arthur.
Go rest for ten minutes, boss. Hannah and Evelyn will read the book!
三天，三个明确的目标，而且亚瑟姑姑那本绿色的旧登记簿已经在桌子上了。我们下个场景见。
See you soon!
